entities.name: Mystic Decree
entities.description: Spell taught to the first Wizard Savant that barred ships and flying vampires from crossing between the Dark Barony and Aysen.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where the Floating Isle lies.

entities.name: Floating Isle
entities.description: Island of Ulgrotha where the school of wizards taught the spell.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Master of the school who taught the spell to the first Wizard Savant.

entities.name: Council of Wizards
entities.description: Body whose permission was required to cross the waters.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Wizard realm protected by the spell.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Ruler whose vampires were kept to roads and coasts by the spell.

entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: Latest Wizard Savant, in charge of maintaining the spell.

events.summary: Feroz taught the Mystic Decree to the first Wizard Savant on the Floating Isle.
events.quote: a spell taught to the first Wizard Savant on the Floating Isle of Ulgrotha by the school's master, Feroz

events.summary: Reveka, the latest Wizard Savant, maintained the Mystic Decree.
events.quote: As the latest Wizard Savant, Reveka was in charge of maintaining the spell.
